episodeTitle.en: This will make you a better decision maker | Annie Duke (Thinking In Bets, former pro poker player)
episodeTitle.zh: 这将让你成为更优秀的决策者 | 安妮·杜克（《在博彩中思考》前职业扑克玩家）

guestBioOfficial.en: Annie Duke is a former professional poker player, a decision-making expert, and a special partner at First Round Capital. She is the author of Thinking in Bets (a national bestseller) and Quit: The Power of Knowing When to Walk Away and the co-founder of the Alliance for Decision Education, a nonprofit whose mission is to improve lives by empowering students through decision skills education. In our conversation, we cover: • What Annie learned from the late Daniel Kahneman
guestBioOfficial.zh: 安妮·杜克曾是职业扑克玩家、决策专家，也是First Round Capital的特别合伙人。她是《在博彩中思考》（全国畅销书）和《退出：知难而退的智慧》的作者，同时也是非营利组织“决策教育联盟”的联合创始人，该组织致力于通过决策技能教育提升人们的生活质量。在我们的对谈中，我们探讨了：• 安妮从已故的丹尼尔·卡尼曼那里学到了什么

title.en: This will make you a better decision maker | Annie Duke (Thinking In Bets, former pro poker player)
title.zh: 这将让你成为更优秀的决策者 | 安妮·杜克（《在博彩中思考》前职业扑克玩家）

summary.en: Annie explains the importance of making intuition explicit so you can discover when it's wrong, and reframes meetings around discovery, discussion, and decision rather than just talking. She introduces pre-mortems paired with kill criteria and argues there is no such thing as a long feedback loop if you identify correlated signals. The conversation draws on lessons from her friend Daniel Kahneman about improving decision quality in companies.
summary.zh: Annie 解释了把直觉“显性化”的重要性，这样你才能发现它何时出错，并把会议重新定义为发现、讨论和决策，而非只是空谈。她介绍了配合“终止标准”的事前复盘（pre-mortem），并认为只要你找到相关信号，就不存在“长反馈循环”。对话借用了她已故好友、心理学家 Daniel Kahneman 的洞见，探讨如何提升企业的决策质量。
